name: inspect_image_ui
description: Read-only: open ChatGPT and report the controls around the most recent image. Generates nothing.

steps._note: Hover/menu controls only exist once the image container is hovered, so this also opens any menu it can find and re-reads the labels.
steps.text: (function(){var out={imgs:0,controls:[],menu:[],hrefs:[]};var im=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('img')).filter(function(i){return i.naturalWidth>=512;});out.imgs=im.length;if(!im.length)return JSON.stringify(out);var img=im[im.length-1];var box=img.closest('div');for(var k=0;k<6&&box&&box.parentElement;k++){box=box.parentElement;}var ev=function(el,t){try{el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(t,{bubbles:true}));}catch(e){}};ev(img,'mouseover');ev(img,'mouseenter');if(box){ev(box,'mouseover');ev(box,'mouseenter');}var grab=function(root){var r=[];[].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('button,a,[role="button"],[role="menuitem"]')).forEach(function(x){var l=(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||x.title||x.textContent||'').trim();if(l&&l.length<70)r.push(l);if(x.tagName==='A'&&x.href)out.hrefs.push(x.href.slice(0,120));});return r;};out.controls=grab(box||document).slice(-30);var more=(box||document).querySelector('[aria-label*="More" i],[data-testid*="more" i]');if(more){more.click();}return JSON.stringify(out);})()
